issues.competing_evidence: Shafter & Hessman (1988) state YZ Cnc does not eclipse; van Paradijs+94 does not establish eclipses. Coppejans+16 §2.4 calls it eclipsing, while Table 1 gives i=15 deg from Patterson+11; Harrison+04 Table 3 lists 38 +/-10 deg cited to Shafter & Hessman, and Patterson+11 Table 1 uses rough i≈40 deg.
issues.why_it_matters: Inclination and eclipse geometry affect physical parameter inference, orbital phasing and comparison of radio emission with the binary plane.
issues.needed_action: For community display, decide whether to publish all conflicting claims without a canonical eclipse/inclination classification, or commission a targeted reanalysis of original photometry and ephemerides.

issues.competing_evidence: Gaia EDR3 geometric posterior 233.49 pc (p16 231.68, p84 235.03); ground parallax 4.4 +/-1.7 mas and Bayesian 222(+50/-42) pc; HST parallax 3.34 +/-0.45 mas with LK-corrected distance ~320 +/-40 pc; K-band template lower bound >=290 pc; Dhillon+00 secondarily quotes ~130 pc from Patterson+84.
issues.why_it_matters: Distance controls luminosities and absolute magnitudes; several methods have different assumptions and one old estimate is secondary-only.
issues.needed_action: Adopt Gaia geometric posterior as current catalog distance while keeping alternatives; if a single community luminosity is needed, decide whether to retain Gaia only or show method-separated historical estimates. Retrieve/recheck Patterson+84 original before using its ~130 pc claim.

issues.competing_evidence: Shafter & Hessman+88 infer q≈0.22, M2≈0.17 Msun and likely M1≈0.75–0.90 under an H-alpha K1 relation; Zhao+05 report q=0.28±0.03, M1=0.46±0.06 and M2=0.13±0.01 using H-beta velocity/superhump calibration; Dai+26 derive q=0.175±0.011 from the newer epsilon(q) relation. None is a dynamical mass ratio.
issues.why_it_matters: WD/donor masses and q drive evolutionary and population comparisons; a canonical branch would materially affect interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Keep model/calibration branches separate and unselected until a dynamical q or improved phase-resolved component-velocity solution is available; if a provisional value is needed, specify calibration and systematic budget.

issues.competing_evidence: Patterson+79 timing during the 1978 supermaximum changes from about 0.09204 d early to 0.0905 d late; Zhao+05 use historical 0.09204 d; Dai+26 report plateau common positive-superhump 0.09043(27) d. These values are stage/state dependent, not competing measurements of one invariant period.
issues.why_it_matters: Superhump period and derived epsilon/q depend on stage; silently selecting or averaging periods distorts q and evolutionary diagnostics.
issues.needed_action: Display early, late and modern plateau values with their event/stage; choose a canonical value only if the catalog defines a stage-specific convention.

issues.competing_evidence: Urban & Sion+06 Table 2 fits Teff≈23000 K to a low-S/N composite IUE spectrum; WD accounts for 24% versus 76% disc FUV and paper says first estimates are approximate. No formal source-specific uncertainty.
issues.why_it_matters: A precise WD Teff is often used for accretion-rate/cooling comparisons, but this fit is strongly composite/model dependent.
issues.needed_action: Keep as approximate model output with explicit warning; for a precise Teff obtain a WD-dominated spectrum or reanalysis with component/continuum constraints.

issues.competing_evidence: Ridder+23 Table 4 values 8.5±0.8e-12 (1–10 keV) and 1.5±0.2e-11 (0.1–10 keV) are approximate 4XMM-DR11 catalog conversions with >=10% errors; exact YZ XMM detection/epoch and absorption convention are not stated there. Hakala+04 separately gives direct 2002 XMM fit fluxes and a model bolometric flux.
issues.why_it_matters: Fluxes may be interpreted as simultaneous with radio or directly comparable to source-specific spectral fits, affecting radio/X-ray ratios.
issues.needed_action: Retain all values separately and request exact 4XMM-DR11 detection row/ID and conversion assumptions before deriving a source-specific luminosity or radio/X-ray ratio.

issues.competing_evidence: A ~26 s optical oscillation is cited secondarily to Pezzuto+92 for one night; Hakala+04 did not recover it and warns short X-ray peaks are consistent with red noise. Original Pezzuto full text was not retrieved.
issues.why_it_matters: Calling it WD spin would imply a secure rapid rotator and could alter classification/evolution interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Do not list a confirmed WD spin unless original full text and an independent repeat establish coherence and physical origin.

issues.competing_evidence: Gaia DR3 +21.9649/-55.1096 mas yr-1; HST FGS +17.5±0.9/-51.8±0.8; Coppejans+16 Table 1 gives +38±8/-58±8 from Skinner, Thorstensen & Lépine 2014. Gaia and HST agree more closely than the older compiled RA component.
issues.why_it_matters: Proper motion affects epoch propagation and astrometric identity checks; disagreement could indicate old catalog/frame or reduction differences.
issues.needed_action: Trace the 2014 compilation to its exact source and coordinate convention/epoch; retain Gaia as current astrometry unless a correction emerges.

issues.competing_evidence: Dhillon+00 finds no donor spectral features and places a 20±5% K-band secondary contribution upper limit using M5V template; >=290 pc distance follows from donor sequence and surface-brightness assumptions. Sherrington & Jameson+83 K=14.365±0.08 is unresolved total system. This conflicts with Gaia 233 pc posterior.
issues.why_it_matters: Misreading the M5V template/derived lower limit as a direct donor measurement or independent geometric distance would bias binary properties.
issues.needed_action: Keep the >=290 pc result marked model dependent; do not adopt M5 or donor Teff without donor detection. If resolving distance conflict, re-evaluate template/scaling assumptions and K epoch/state.

issues.competing_evidence: Dhillon+00 attributes an approximate ~130 pc prior distance to Patterson+84 based on H-beta/continuum discussion; Patterson+84 original full text was not retrieved during this audit.
issues.why_it_matters: This is a large discrepancy if treated as a real geometric distance, but current claim is secondary-only and method may be obsolete.
issues.needed_action: Retrieve and inspect the original Patterson+84 YZ Cnc entry/method before retaining a precise value; meanwhile label as secondary report only and exclude from preferred distance.
